title: The Chess Player Appears
next_chapter_hook: When Cang Yutian spoke the words 'Ten thousand years ago in that game, you and I were accomplices,' Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his chest vibrate violently, as if some sealed memory was awakening.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, an ancient and majestic voice suddenly resounded from the depths of the Source of Destiny—it was the voice of the Ultimate Chess Player Cang Yutian, announcing that this ancient chess game had finally entered its final stage. The entire Source of Destiny began to tremble violently, the chaotic mist parting like an ebbing tide to reveal a straight passage. At the end of the passage, a figure approached slowly. It was an ordinary-looking elder, dressed in plain white robes, with white hair and beard, his face serene as an ancient well. But when his gaze swept over Chen Ji, every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end—that was no mortal's gaze, but the gaze of Heavenly Providence's Eye examining an ant. 'Chen Ji.' Cang Yutian's voice carried not a trace of emotion, 'You arrived earlier than I anticipated.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji collected himself, clasped his hands in salute, his tone平静得近乎冷漠) Junior Chen Ji greets the senior. (He lowered his eyes in thought for a moment, then suddenly smiled slightly) However, the junior is somewhat curious—does the senior's 'final stage' refer to the endgame of the chess game you arranged, or... does it carry deeper meaning? (He lifted his eyes to gaze directly at Cang Yutian, his gaze free of fear, only scrutiny) The senior regards yourself as an ancient chess player, surely you have calculated everything. So this junior dares to ask—what do you want me to do, bringing me to the Source of Destiny?

text.content: Cang Yutian did not answer immediately. He walked closer slowly, each step seemingly stepping on Chen Ji's heartstrings, bringing a suffocating resonance. When he stopped three zhang away from Chen Ji, a vast and boundless aura pressed down abruptly. Chen Ji's knees bent slightly, nearly causing him to kneel. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, forcibly sustaining this pressure. The Tianji Record Fragment in his chest burned intensely, as if it would incinerate him to ashes. 'Sustained it?' Cang Yutian said lightly, his tone carrying an imperceptible hint of appreciation, 'It seems that fragment of the record has tempered you to be more resilient than I anticipated.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji wiped the blood trickling from the corner of his mouth, straightened up, his gaze like a blade) The senior's greeting, this junior has noted. (He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressed the surging qi and blood, his voice反而愈发平静) But this junior wishes to know more—who exactly is the senior? To this junior's knowledge, in all the myriad realms of existence, those who possess such pressure can be counted on one's fingers. (He paused, shifting his approach) Or could it be... the senior is not 'human' at all?

text.content: Upon hearing this, Cang Yutian actually fell silent for a rare moment. 'Not human?' he repeated quietly, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, 'That description is not entirely inaccurate.' He waved his hand, and the surrounding chaotic mist solidified abruptly, forming a massive mirror. What the mirror reflected was not a human figure, but a boundless light—that radiance was dazzling to the extreme, as if containing the origin and end of the entire universe. 'Ten thousand years ago, the Heavenly Providence's Origin collapsed.' Cang Yutian's voice became ethereal, 'In that great collapse, countless fragmented consciousnesses were born. And I—the first fragment to possess autonomous consciousness.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He looked at the light in the mirror, then at Cang Yutian's serene face, and a terrifying thought formed in his mind. 'So... the senior is the first free will born from the collapse of Heavenly Providence's Origin?' His voice turned slightly hoarse, 'You broke free from the cycle of Heavenly Providence, yet are trapped in another cycle—the chess game you yourself arranged?' Cang Yutian did not deny. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze profound as an abyss. 'You are very clever, Chen Ji.' he said slowly, 'Clever enough that I once suspected whether you might also be one of my chess pieces.'

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji snorted coldly, meeting Cang Yutian's gaze without yielding) The senior jokes. This junior is merely a somewhat lucky废物. If truly a chess piece of the senior, I would have been crushed to dust long ago. (He shifted his approach, his gaze turning sharp) However, this junior is quite curious—since the senior has transcended Heavenly Providence, why still arrange this ancient chess game? Is it to oppose... that thing? (His voice lowered several degrees) The Heavenly Providence's Eye.

text.content: The four characters '天道之眼' left his lips, and Cang Yutian's gaze finally changed—it was an extremely complex expression, carrying both wariness and anger, but also a trace of indescribable... sorrow? 'You indeed know of its existence.' Cang Yutian sighed deeply, 'It seems Mo Xiansheng told you quite a lot.' He waved his hand again, and the light in the mirror transformed, reflecting a massive vertical pupil. That vertical pupil was cold, majestic, supreme, as if the entire universe was merely a speck of dust in its eye. 'It is the true chess player of this ancient chess game.' Cang Yutian's voice turned ice-cold, 'And you and I—are both its chess pieces.'

choice.prompt: Facing the truth revealed by Cang Yutian, Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to choose to oppose this ancient conspiracy, or to seek cooperation with Cang Yutian?

choices.description: This is too extraordinary. Why would an ancient chess player reveal everything to this ant? There must be something amiss here.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian May Therefore Be Displeased

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, a trace of vigilance flashing in his eyes) The senior speaks well, but this junior has one point of confusion. You have arranged an ancient chess game, playing the myriad realms of existence between your fingers. Yet now you reveal these shocking secrets to this junior—a mere Foundation Building废物? (He laughed coldly) If the senior truly regarded this junior as a chess piece, you should remain hidden in the shadows, not personally appear. So... have you encountered some trouble that requires this junior's assistance?

text.content: Cang Yutian looked at Chen Ji, his appreciation in his gaze growing even stronger. 'You are indeed as the rumors say—calculating everything, meticulous in thought.' He applauded lightly, 'Indeed worthy of being the only one who could reach this place.' 'Yes, I do need your assistance.' Cang Yutian admitted frankly, 'But more importantly—you also need my assistance.' He waved his hand again, and the image in the mirror changed once more. This time, it reflected a blurry figure—that figure was strikingly similar to Chen Ji, yet wore entirely different ancient robes.

choices.description: Since the chess game has reached its final stage, what is the true purpose of Cang Yutian's ancient layout? Can breaking the Heavenly Providence cycle truly create a free world?
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian May Have Set a Verbal Trap

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down) Very well, this junior temporarily believes the senior's words. But this junior still has a question—the senior said you arranged the ancient chess game to break the Heavenly Providence cycle and create a truly free world. (He stared directly at Cang Yutian) However... what exactly is this 'free world'? How does the senior intend to 'break' it? Destroy everything that exists, or... is there another path?

text.content: Cang Yutian was silent for a long while. 'Destroy?' He shook his head, 'Destruction is the most foolish method. The Heavenly Providence's Eye maintains the cycle through destruction and rebirth; each great calamity is an opportunity for it to draw power.' His gaze turned profound: 'True breaking is to end the cycle—to ensure destiny no longer轮回, allowing all beings to control their own future.' 'And to accomplish this...' Cang Yutian looked at Chen Ji, 'I need one thing. The complete version of the Tianji Record.'

"The complete version of the Tianji Record.

These six words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. He instinctively pressed his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment was violently trembling, as if sensing something.

"Do you want the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold. "So you set up all of this—including Ling Yuan, the Xuanwu Sect, even the Demonic Path invasion—all just to seize the Tianji Record from me?"

Cang Yutian shook his head: "Not seizure. It's—fusion."

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji frowns deeply) Fusion? What does Senior mean by that?

(He sneers) The Tianji Record is my lifeblood—every glimpse of the future costs precious Heavenly Fate. If Senior demands fusion, I'd like to know—what would remain of me afterward?

(His tone turns cold) Or is my very life part of Senior's chess game?

text.content:
Cang Yutian fell silent again.

This time, his silence carried a hint of... complex emotions. Chen Ji敏锐ly caught this, and alarm bells rang in his heart.

"Chen Ji." Cang Yutian suddenly spoke, his voice dropping low. "Do you know who the original owner of the Tianji Record was?"

Chen Ji froze. Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this question.

"Not me." Cang Yutian gazed at Chen Ji, a deeply profound meaning flickering in his eyes. "And not you either."

"It was another person. Someone... inextricably linked to you."

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's words touched upon Chen Ji's deepest secret—his mysterious origins. Chen Ji must decide whether to probe further.

choices.text: Inquire about the truth of his origins
choices.description: "A person inextricably linked to me"—this touched upon the answer Chen Ji most wanted to know. He had to understand his true connection to the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Key clue to unraveling the mystery of his origins
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may use this to coerce him

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, but he quickly suppressed his emotions) ...Who is that person?

(He stepped forward, his gaze fixed intently on Cang Yutian) Is my connection to the Tianji Record related to my origins? Is it related to my missing sister Chen Nian?

(He took a deep breath) Or is that person... me? Me from ten thousand years ago?

text.content:
Cang Yutian watched Chen Ji's reaction, a flash of approval and... some indescribable emotion crossing his eyes.

"Ten thousand years ago, you and I were co-conspirators." His voice suddenly dropped low. "You lost all your memories, and I lost my freedom. We both thought we were chess masters, not knowing we were pieces from the very beginning."

"That person—that was the you of the past."

choices.description: "Inextricably linked to me"—this phrase is too suspicious. Cang Yutian might be using the mystery of his origins to lure him into a trap. Must remain calm.
choices.visible_reward: See through Cang Yutian's true intentions

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji took a step back, his urgency quickly concealed, replaced by his usual coldness) What Senior says grows more mystical by the word.

I'm merely a waste—no talent, how could I understand any ancient grand scheme? As for "the me of the past"—(he sneered) if Senior thinks to shake my resolve with such words, you've miscalculated.

(Arms crossed) What I'm more interested in is—why Senior is telling me all this. What exactly do you want?

text.content:
Cang Yutian watched Chen Ji's reaction and actually revealed a meaningful smile.

"Good." He nodded. "This is the Chen Ji I know—calculating, never trusting anyone easily."

He clasped his hands behind his back, his gaze turning profound: "Since you don't wish to know, I'll be direct. What I want is simple—to cooperate with you, to jointly oppose the Eye of Heavenly Dao in the final chess game."

"In exchange, I'll tell you... where your sister Chen Nian is."

Chen Nian.

These two characters struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. His breathing abruptly quickened, his knuckles white from tension.

The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, the visions blurry—as always, every foresight involving Chen Nian was like this, never showing her figure clearly. This should have been Chen Ji's greatest weakness, yet Cang Yutian casually unveiled it.

"You..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. "You know where Niannian is?"

Cang Yutian gave no answer, merely watching him silently.

The meaning in that gaze was clear—this was the bargaining chip.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and when he opened them again, his usual composure had returned) Clever scheme.

Using news of my sister to coerce cooperation—Senior is indeed an ancient chess master.

(He stared directly at Cang Yutian, his tone icy) But I too have a condition. If Senior truly knows where Niannian is, please tell me first—is she still alive?

(He stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade) As long as Senior answers this question, I'm willing to hear your terms for cooperation. Otherwise... I'd rather go down fighting.

text.content:
Go down fighting.

When these four words left Chen Ji's lips, a flash of surprise crossed Cang Yutian's eyes, followed by deep appreciation.

"You haven't changed after all." He murmured. "Ten thousand years ago you dared to play against Heaven, and ten thousand years later you still dare to risk your life."

He waved his hand, and the mirror's image shifted again. This time, it showed a dark underground space—countless chains extended from all directions, converging on a figure at the center.

The figure was blurred, but Chen Ji recognized that familiar silhouette at a glance.

"Niannian..."

choice.prompt: The blurred figure appearing in the mirror is likely Chen Nian. Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this sudden shock.

choices.description: Having seen his sister's whereabouts, Chen Ji absolutely cannot sit by. He wants Cang Yutian to rescue Chen Nian first before discussing cooperation.
choices.visible_reward: To gain leverage for rescuing Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian might use this to extort more

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji stares at the figure in the mirror, voice trembling yet resolute) That's Nian Nian... she's still alive!

(He turns sharply to Cang Yutian, eyes blazing with raging fury) Tell me—where is she imprisoned! I must rescue her!

(His tone turns icy cold) As for cooperation... we'll discuss that after Nian Nian is safe. If you dare harm a single hair on her head, I, Chen Ji, swear—I will make your eternal chess game, checkmate!

text.content:
Cang Yutian observes Chen Ji's reaction, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.

"You think I don't want to save her?" His voice suddenly drops low, "The place where Chen Nian is imprisoned is precisely where the Heavenly Eye's true form resides—the deepest part of the Heavenly Mechanism Hall."

"That is forbidden ground even I cannot set foot in." His gaze meets Chen Ji's, "And the only key that can open that door... is in your hands."

"The complete version of the Tianji Record."

choices.description: Though the news of Chen Nian enraged Chen Ji, he could not lose his rationality. Since Cang Yutian knew Chen Nian's whereabouts, he must have deeper schemes. He must first understand all of this.
choices.visible_reward: See the full picture of the situation
choices.risk_hint: Might be exploited by Cang Yutian using this mindset

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji closes his eyes, forcing himself to calm down. When he opens them again after a moment, the raging fury has been suppressed deep within his gaze) ... Very well.

(He says heavily) The junior understands. Since Senior knows Nian Nian's whereabouts, you naturally understand the difficulty of rescuing her.

(He stares directly at Cang Yutian) So Senior's true purpose isn't just to obtain the Tianji Record fragment in my hands—you want me to help you open that door, correct?

(He sneers) Senior might as well speak clearly—what exactly do you want me to do? Enter the Heavenly Mechanism Hall, seize control of the Heavenly Eye?

text.content:
Cang Yutian nods, a glimmer of approval flickering in his gaze.

"Precisely. You truly are that person—through countless reincarnations, your essence remains unchanged."

His voice becomes solemn: "What I want you to do is not seize control, but—to completely annihilate the Heavenly Eye."

"Only through this can the cycle be broken. All beings can gain true freedom." Cang Yutian gazes at Chen Ji, "And you can rescue your sister—she in the Heavenly Mechanism Hall is precisely the key maintaining the Heavenly Eye's cycle... the Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Heavenly Fate Lock Key.

The words make Chen Ji's blood nearly freeze. He recalls what Mo Xiansheng once said—that Chen Nian's existence would disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight, that any prophetic vision containing her was blurred.

So that's how it is.

She's not disrupting the Tianji Record, but... the key itself. The key the Heavenly Eye uses to lock away destiny.

"So from the very beginning..." Chen Ji's voice is hoarse, "Nian Nian being taken by the Holy Sect wasn't a coincidence?"

Cang Yutian shakes his head: "No. She is a piece arranged by the Heavenly Eye, resonating with the Tianji Record fragment in your hands. You believed you were pursuing her, but actually... you're both on its chessboard."

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji falls silent for a long while. When he speaks again, his voice is terrifyingly calm) What a fine Heavenly Eye.

(He sneers) What a fine eternal chess game. The junior thought himself a chess player, when from beginning to end he was merely a piece in its hands.

(He raises his head, gaze sharp as a blade) But the junior has one thing he doesn't understand—if both I and Nian Nian are on its chessboard, then what about Senior? Is Senior also a piece? Or is Senior... another chess player?

(He stares directly at Cang Yutian) The junior needs to know which side Senior truly stands on.

text.content:
Cang Yutian gazes at Chen Ji, silent for a long moment.

"Me?" He suddenly laughs, the smile carrying a hint of bitterness, "I am the first fragment to break free from the chessboard, yet precisely因此被困在自己的棋局中万劫不复。"

他负手而立，目光深邃："万年前，我与那个人联手，试图打破循环。但我们失败了——他失去了一切，而我被迫成为新的执棋者。"

"万年来，我一直在等待一个机会。"他看向陈机，"等待那个人……再次出现。"

"等待你。"

命运之源再次震颤。镜中的画面忽然模糊，取而代之的是一幅古老的画面——

万年前的战场。

无数身影在厮杀，天空被血与火染成猩红。而在战场中央，两个身影背对背而立，面对着铺天盖地的敌人。

其中一个身影，穿着与陈机一模一样的衣袍。

另一个身影——正是眼前这位万古棋手，仓御天。

"这……"陈机瞳孔骤缩，"这是……"

"这就是万年前的那一局。"仓御天的声音低沉，"我与你——曾经的我们——并肩而战。"

画面中，两个身影配合得天衣无缝，仿佛心意相通。他们杀入敌阵深处，直取天道之眼的核心。

但就在最后一刻，天道之眼爆发出恐怖的力量。画面中的陈机被击飞，鲜血染红了长空。

"那一战，我们输了一招。"仓御天闭上眼，"你被抹去了一切记忆，而我被迫成为它的傀儡……直到今天。"

当仓御天再次睁眼时，目光中的复杂情绪尽数收敛，取而代之的是前所未有的郑重。

"陈机。"他的声音如同大道之音，在整个命运之源中回荡，"万古棋局已到最终阶段。天道之眼即将完成它的终极布局——届时，众生都将沦为它的养料。"

"而你，是唯一能阻止它的人。"

他伸出手，掌心浮现一枚古朴的棋子。

"这是万年前我与你的约定之证。"仓御天道，"现在，我以它为礼，邀请你——与我进行最后一局对弈。"

"胜者，将决定整个宇宙的命运。"
